item.title: 23andMe/HealthEx DNA Data
item.description:
• Summary: 23andMe and startup HealthEx are partnering to link consumer genetic data with electronic health records (EHRs), according to STAT News. The collaboration aims to build a large, real‑world dataset that could accelerate drug discovery and biomarker identification. Privacy advocates caution about consent and data security, while researchers see potential for improving polygenic risk scores and pharmacogenomics. The deal marks another step toward integrating direct‑to‑consumer genomics into mainstream clinical research.

  • Sources: STAT News
